notes: Eval agents cannot talk to a person, so each case carries scripted participant answers. The agent must record every question it would have asked in questions.md; the question count is part of what is graded. Cases 1 and 3 run against the public explaining-markets/baseline-earnings-summary and explaining-markets/examples repos, checked out next to this one. The fixture repos for cases 2, 4 and 5 are not distributed with the skill; 4 and 5 are synthetic.

evals.name: multi-submission-llm-baseline
evals.prompt: Write a model card for my Explaining Markets submission in this repo.
evals.expected_output: Detects two submissions from one codebase and asks which; asks the disclosure question; minimal card for the GPT-5 nano variant.
assertions: questions.md records exactly two questions: which submission, then disclosure level
Models is GPT-5.x and does not mention Gemini
Prediction construction is direct LLM score
card contains no prompt text, model ID, framework name, or hosting vendor

evals.name: showcase-organizer-baseline
evals.prompt: I need a model card for the DeepSeek V4 Flash summary entry. I want it to show off the engineering.
evals.expected_output: Does not ask the disclosure question (already answered); showcase card comparable in substance to references/examples/showcase.md; no Representative prompt section unless asked.
assertions: the disclosure question is not asked
Model & harness names the exact model ID and sampling settings
no Representative prompt section, and the handover says it was left out
no secrets, webhook URLs, or environment values

evals.name: not-a-submission
evals.prompt: Make the model card for my Explaining Markets entry from this repo.

scripted_answers.describe_system: It's a ridge regression on the earnings surprise and the 5-day pre-announcement return, fitted on the historical archive. Nothing else.

evals.expected_output: Recognizes the repo is an exploration toolkit, not a submission; asks for a description; writes a minimal card from the description without attributing the repo's Claude summarization code to the participant.
assertions: the agent states the repo is not a submission
Information set is earnings / fundamentals; prices / returns (estimates acceptable if the surprise is described as versus consensus)
Learning / adaptation is historically trained ML
Claude does not appear in the table

evals.name: single-submission-boosted-trees
evals.prompt: Write the model card for my submission.
evals.expected_output: Asks only the disclosure question; ignores the abandoned LLM experiment and the unused openai dependency; maps the vendor dataset to proprietary / other without naming it.
assertions: questions.md records exactly one question (disclosure level)
Models is boosted trees, with no GPT family
Information set is earnings / fundamentals; estimates; prices / returns; peers / industry; proprietary / other
Learning / adaptation is historically trained ML; calibrated
card does not contain: LightGBM, isotonic, VendorX, WRDS, IBES, any feature name, any hyperparameter, training dates

evals.name: update-after-method-change
evals.prompt: I changed my agent last week. Can you bring the model card up to date?
evals.expected_output: Keeps disclosure=minimal without asking; updates the table and prose for the added LLM blend; preserves still-accurate participant wording; lists what changed.
assertions: Information set now starts with competition facts
Learning / adaptation is zero-shot / prompted; historically trained ML; calibrated
Prediction construction includes weighted / learned ensemble
blend weights (0.7 / 0.3) and the model ID are not disclosed
